headline: NINtec Systems Limited: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4)
sum: NINtec Systems Limited has submitted a substantial acquisition disclosure to NSE under SEBI Takeover Regulation 31(4), signalling a material change in shareholding that triggers mandatory disclosure obligations.
detail: The company has submitted a disclosure document to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This mandatory filing arises when a person or group acquires shares representing 5% or more of paid-up voting capital of a listed company. The specific acquirer, shareholding percentage, consideration and deal structure are contained in the disclosure document filed with the exchange.
